models_evaluated: dual-engine RAG (knowledge graph + vector search) system

links.outcome: Guideline compliance and factual consistency of RAG-grounded answers versus standalone LLM on 300-question benchmark
links.effect: Dual-engine RAG: 98.5% guideline compliance, 97.8% factual consistency; standalone LLM 81.4% guideline compliance; single-vector RAG 93.7%.
links.quote: The dual-engine RAG framework yielded a guideline compliance rate of 98.5% and factual consistency of 97.8%, outperforming standalone large language models (81.4% guideline compliance) and single-vector RAG approaches (93.7%).

unlisted_practices: Fully local, offline deployment of LLM system to preserve patient data privacy
Knowledge graph ontology combined with vector retrieval (dual-engine RAG)
Progressive multi-turn dialogue guidance for resident training

screen.reason: Evaluates a dual-engine RAG architecture (knowledge graph plus semantic search) compared against standalone LLM and single-vector RAG on clinical guideline compliance and factual consistency for residency training.
